title: Woodstock Music Festival
description:
The **Woodstock Music & Art Fair** took place from August 15-18, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York. It attracted an audience of over 400,000 people.

The festival featured iconic performances by Jimi Hendrix, Janis Joplin, The Who, and many others. It became a defining moment of the counterculture movement and the "hippie" era.

Despite logistical challenges including shortages of food and medical supplies, the festival is remembered as a peaceful celebration of music and youth culture.
